text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A in stages at gains felt satisfying, but I should avoid trimming automatically just to lock in profit; weigh its outlook and portfolio role each time.","Buying more Stock A before later selling at a loss showed me that adding to a position needs a clear thesis and risk limit, not just confidence in a familiar holding.","After periods of decline followed by a modest rebound, I should stay disciplined: review fundamentals and diversification, and avoid letting short-term account changes dictate trades."]}
